geometry: Semelle rectangulaire, deux niveaux courbes superposes en forme de vagues. Stele sculptee en voilier: coque incurvee basse et deux surfaces de voile effilees separant une ligne de mat courbe. Galet clair pose a gauche.
fixed_features: Voilier sculpte complet, coque et voiles
removable_accessories: Galet oval clair pose sur la dalle a gauche, probablement decoratif
material_zones: Base et vagues bleu sombre; bateau en pierre claire veinee. Galet en pierre claire.
ambiguity: La fixation du galet n'est pas visible; il pourrait etre une petite plaque ovale. Traiter son retrait avec prudence selon la regle generale du brief.
generation_note: Conserver le contraste entre bateau et base ainsi que les vides/limites des deux voiles; ne pas simplifier en stele triangulaire.
decisionPilote: Bicolore conserve : base et vagues varient; voilier clair veine reste fixe. Le galet clair separe est traite comme accessoire pose, fixation non visible. Coque, voiles et leurs limites sont structurelles.

specificationGeneration.geometry: a compact cinerary monument with a rectangular stone plinth, two layered wave-shaped stone surfaces and an upright sculpted light-stone sailboat with a curved hull and two tapered sails
specificationGeneration.stoneAreas: only the rectangular plinth and the two wave-shaped base levels, which are dark blue granite in the source
specificationGeneration.fixedAreas: Keep the complete sculpted sailboat, including its curved hull, both sails and the curved mast division, in the original light grey-white veined stone. Preserve its natural veining, all gaps, incised dividing lines and silhouette.
specificationGeneration.extraConstraints: Do not recolor the light sailboat with the selected base material. Do not turn the two sails into one triangular headstone or flatten the layered waves.
specificationGeneration.masterDescription: Preserve the rectangular lowest plinth and two curved wave-shaped layers above it. Keep the large sculpted sailboat at the rear: a low curved hull, two tapered billowing sails and the curved central mast division. The dark blue base and waves are the variable primary stone; the complete light veined boat remains fixed secondary stone.
specificationGeneration.removeDescription: Remove the loose light oval pebble resting on the left of the slab and its reflections. Leave the complete wave-shaped slab underneath intact.
specificationGeneration.interpretationNote: Bicolore conserve : base et vagues varient; voilier clair veine reste fixe. Le galet clair separe est traite comme accessoire pose, fixation non visible. Coque, voiles et leurs limites sont structurelles.
